sample_unit: models trained (12 ML/DL models on 2 datasets)
models_evaluated: 12 machine learning and deep learning models (not individually named in text)

links.outcome: Performance estimates under non-cross-subject versus cross-subject (leakage-free) test splits
links.effect: NCS splits consistently overestimated model performance, with discrepancies increasing with task and model complexity; DL models showed markedly higher NCS than CS performance, generally with statistical significance.
links.quote: NCS splits consistently overestimated model performances, with discrepancies increasing alongside task and model complexity.

screen.reason: Empirically investigates validation methodology (cross-subject vs non-cross-subject data splitting) to assess model generalizability and avoid overestimating clinical performance in rehabilitation AI.

primary.practice: cross-subject data splitting / subject-level validation design
